title: The Monk Who Ate Anything
why_movie: A real first-person Kevin story with a place, people and a turn: the Shaolin monk who swears he has no dietary restriction, then only orders vegetables for a week - until Kevin calls him on it and serves him steak.
keep: I'm with Xi Yanming, the Shaolin monk
So he comes to my house
So we go to the restaurant
a vegetable fried rice. So we eat
After a week, I said, Shifu
the only thing I see you eat is vegetables
And he looks at me and he says, I like a vegetable
I eat steak and I love it. I eat anything
Okay. I'm serving you a steak tonight
What a beautiful way to live

scenes.on: I'm with Xi Yanming, the Shaolin monk
scenes.gen: An elderly Asian Buddhist monk with a shaved head, wearing saffron and orange temple robes, standing in an ancient stone courtyard in China at dawn, mist drifting past red wooden pillars
scenes.move: the monk slowly bows his head, then opens his eyes and looks up

scenes.on: I know you're a vegetarian. So what do you eat?
scenes.gen: A home dining room, empty plates on a wooden table, a stand-in host in a dark sweater sitting across from an Asian Buddhist monk in orange robes, warm evening lamp light
scenes.move: the monk shakes his head and gestures with an open hand while he speaks

scenes.on: I would like a bowl of vegetable noodle soup
scenes.gen: A small Chinese restaurant booth lit by red lanterns, a round table crowded with a bowl of vegetable noodle soup, a plate of stir-fried vegetables and a plate of vegetable fried rice, chopsticks resting on the bowls
scenes.move: steam rises from the bowl of noodle soup as chopsticks lift a few vegetables

scenes.on: This guy ate the steak and asked for another piece
scenes.gen: A dinner table at night lit by candlelight, a thick grilled steak on a white plate in front of an Asian Buddhist monk in orange robes, a fork and knife in his hands
scenes.move: the monk lifts a forkful of steak to his mouth and smiles while chewing

payoff: This guy ate the steak and asked for another piece
caption:
Comment "WISH" and I'll send you Kevin Trudeau's 14 Your Wish Is Your Command audios. Free.

Kevin Trudeau says he tracked down a real Shaolin monk and had him move into his house to learn the temple's secrets. The monk said he was vegetarian, then insisted he had no dietary restriction at all - he "ate anything."

For a week, every single meal the monk ordered was vegetables. Kevin finally called him out on it.

What the monk said next - and what happened the night Kevin served him steak - is the part people don't expect.

{episode}

The 14 audios are Kevin teaching how to use your mind to get what you want in life, recorded live at a private event in the Alps.

Most people will scroll past this. A few will comment "WISH" and start listening tonight.

No message within a minute? Look in your message requests, or use the link in my bio.
